title: Systems That Keep Their Promises
subtitle: A field guide to building dependable data products
author: Cesar Pedrin
description: An original, practical guide to the decisions behind reliable data systems: what to promise, where facts live, how writes become durable, why read models drift, and how to recover when reality gets messy.
coverNote: A practical guide for engineers who want their systems to behave as clearly as their product promises.
